[SWS_Dcm_01566]Authentication distance supervision ⌈If DcmDspAuthentica-
tionMileageOffsetLimit is configured and DcmDspAuthenticationPersist-
StateModeRuleRef is evaluated to false, the Dcm shall monitor the travelled dis-
tance with active authenticated state and return to de-authenticated state if the current
DcmDspAuthenticationMileageInformation is greater than the DcmDspAu-
thenticationMileageInformation when the authenticated state was reached
plus the value of DcmDspAuthenticationMileageOffsetLimit.⌋
